name: Secret Word Duel
hook: Pick a secret word. Crack theirs first.
how: Each player picks a secret 5-letter word, then you take turns guessing the other's. Green is the right letter in the right spot, yellow is in the word somewhere, grey is not in it; fewest guesses wins.
controls: Type or tap the on-screen keyboard, Enter to guess
uses: Your word is sealed so only you can read it (the host checks the clues, so it can too).
The host's browser checks every guess and works out the clues; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot rival takes the empty seat, and a friend who joins takes it at the next pick.
Duels won, shown after every duel.
ideas: Add a hint button that costs one guess
Use only animal names as secret words
